labs.title: Secure Copilot and AI activity with Microsoft Purview DSPM
labs.summary: Use simulated Microsoft Purview DSPM to complete setup tasks, enable AI policies, review sensitive AI interactions, run an assessment, and choose remediation.
labs.scenario: Contoso is preparing a Microsoft 365 Copilot pilot and wants Microsoft Purview to monitor and reduce AI-related data risks. In the **simulated Microsoft Purview** portal, open the current **Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)** solution, complete the setup checklist, enable one-click AI protection policies, review reports for AI interactions that include sensitive information, run a data risk assessment for top SharePoint sites, and choose a remediation for an overshared HR site. The classic **DSPM for AI** name is still documented, but this lab uses the current DSPM entry point.
learningObjectives: Identify the current Data Security Posture Management entry point in Microsoft Purview
Enable prerequisite setup tasks for AI observability and auditing
Create one-click policies for risky AI usage and sensitive data interactions
Use reports and data risk assessments to identify and remediate oversharing risks
prerequisites: Know that Purview supports audit, DLP, labels, eDiscovery, retention, and DSPM capabilities for Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions

steps.title: Open the current DSPM solution
steps.instruction: From **Solutions**, open **DSPM**. Use the current **Data Security Posture Management** entry, not **DSPM for AI (classic)**.
steps.hint: The classic tile is shown for awareness, but the current solution is labeled DSPM.
steps.explanation: Microsoft Learn now describes Data Security Posture Management as the current solution, with DSPM for AI retained as the classic experience.

steps.title: Complete the get started checklist
steps.instruction: On **Data Security Posture Management**, mark these setup tasks complete: **Turn on Microsoft Purview Audit**, **Install Microsoft Purview browser extension**, and **Onboard devices to Microsoft Purview**.
steps.hint: Use **Mark complete** on each row in the Get started checklist.
steps.explanation: Audit captures supported Copilot interactions; the browser extension and device onboarding provide signals for third-party AI site activity.

rules.description: Audit, browser extension, and device onboarding are complete
rules.failureFeedback: Complete all three setup checklist rows.

steps.title: Create required one-click AI policies
steps.instruction: Open **Recommendations** and use **Create policy** for **Detect risky interactions in AI apps**, **Detect sensitive info shared with AI via network**, and **Protect items with sensitivity labels from Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent processing**.
steps.hint: Do not dismiss recommendations; create the policies from their row actions.
steps.explanation: These one-click policies help detect risky AI usage, identify sensitive data shared with AI, and protect labeled sensitive data from Copilot and agent processing.

rules.description: The required DSPM AI policies are enabled

DSPM for AI - Detect sensitive info shared with AI via network
DSPM for AI - Protect sensitive data from Copilot processing

rules.failureFeedback: Create all three required policies from Recommendations.

steps.title: Review sensitive AI interaction reports
steps.instruction: Open **Reports**, select **AI interactions containing sensitive info**, and choose **Mark reviewed** after inspecting the interactions table.
steps.hint: The report shows the app category, top app, sensitive information type, referenced file, and control.
steps.explanation: Purview reports and activity data help admins understand where AI prompts or responses involve sensitive information.

rules.description: The sensitive AI interactions report was reviewed
rules.failureFeedback: Open the sensitive AI interactions report and select Mark reviewed.

steps.title: Run the oversharing data risk assessment
steps.instruction: Open **Data risk assessments** and select **Run assessment** for the **Top SharePoint sites** oversharing assessment.
steps.hint: The results table appears on the same page after the assessment completes.
steps.explanation: Data risk assessments identify overshared SharePoint content that Microsoft 365 Copilot or agents could surface to users who already have access.

rules.failureFeedback: Run the Data risk assessments oversharing assessment.

steps.title: Choose a remediation for HR-Internal
steps.instruction: In the assessment results, for **HR-Internal**, choose **Apply sensitivity label**. Review the other options: **Restrict access** constrains SharePoint access, and **Start site access review** asks the owner to clean up permissions.
steps.hint: Use the row action on HR-Internal in the Results table.
steps.explanation: Sensitivity labels add protection and help Copilot display and honor sensitivity. Restricted access or site access reviews are appropriate when broad permissions must be reduced.

rules.description: A remediation was selected for HR-Internal
rules.failureFeedback: Apply the Confidential - HR sensitivity label remediation to HR-Internal.

labs.solution:
1. Open **Solutions** and choose **DSPM**. Use the current **Data Security Posture Management** solution; **DSPM for AI (classic)** is the previous experience.
2. On **Data Security Posture Management**, in the **Get started checklist**, mark **Turn on Microsoft Purview Audit**, **Install Microsoft Purview browser extension**, and **Onboard devices to Microsoft Purview** complete.
3. Open **Recommendations** and select **Create policy** for **Detect risky interactions in AI apps**, **Detect sensitive info shared with AI via network**, and **Protect items with sensitivity labels from Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent processing**. This creates **DSPM for AI - Detect risky AI usage**, **DSPM for AI - Detect sensitive info shared with AI via network**, and **DSPM for AI - Protect sensitive data from Copilot processing**.
4. Open **Reports**, select **AI interactions containing sensitive info**, review the interactions, and select **Mark reviewed**.
5. Open **Data risk assessments** and select **Run assessment** for the top SharePoint sites oversharing assessment.
6. In the results, for **HR-Internal**, choose **Apply sensitivity label**. Purview helps protect Copilot interactions because sensitivity labels are honored, encrypted content requires appropriate **VIEW** and **EXTRACT** usage rights, supported prompts and responses are audited, eDiscovery can search supported interaction data, and retention can preserve Copilot interactions when configured.
